subject.title: feat(github-copilot): support GitHub Enterprise data-residency Copilot auth

question: Should OpenClaw accept GitHub Copilot Enterprise data-residency as a bundled `github-copilot` provider auth/config/env/SDK contract in this PR?
rationale: The implementation appears coherent and proven, but it creates public provider setup behavior and credential-routing policy that automation should not approve as product direction on its own.

options.title: Accept the Enterprise contract
options.body: Proceed with this bundled-provider feature after conflict resolution, exact-head CI, and any maintainer-requested release-note context.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask the contributor to reduce or reshape the public env/config/SDK surface while keeping tenant routing covered by tests.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers do not want GHE data-residency support owned by the bundled `github-copilot` provider yet.

recommendation.title: Accept the Enterprise contract
recommendation.body: Proceed with this bundled-provider feature after conflict resolution, exact-head CI, and any maintainer-requested release-note context.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is product/API acceptance for a bundled provider contract, and steipete has the strongest recent provider-runtime ownership trail.
